Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1) Undertaking: -The bidder shall submit a duly notarized affidavit that he/she will provide vehicle within 0 7 days from the date of the issuance of work order. (2) The bidder must produce evidence of possessing adequate working capital (at least 20% of the "Annual

ized Estimated value) inclusive of access to lines of credit and availability of other financial resources to m eet the requirement, issued by a Practicing Chartered Accountant having a membership number with Instit ute of Chartered Accountants of India. Such certificate should contain the Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) within one months of the end date of bid. (3) Vehicles are required to be covered under appropriate Insurance as per MV Act and should have been paid up-to-date Road Tax, Fees, Fitness certificate, pollution under control certificate etc. as per MV Act, as the case may be along with valid Registration and valid Driving License of the driver. Copy of original regis tration certificate, up to date road tax, valid insurance, valid permit & valid fitness certificate must be sub mitted by the contractor before issuance of work order and deployment of vehicles (4) "The contractor shall make their own arrangements for the stay and accommodation of drivers and staf f during outstation assignments at their own cost. No accommodation or lodging will be provided by us." (5) The vehicle may be engaged on Sundays and other holidays during the period of contract as required. (6) If a driver becomes sick or unavailable, the contractor must provide a substitute without extra payment . (7) a. Driver must be medically fit and non-alcoholic. b. In case of misconduct or negligence, the driver must be replaced within 24 hours. c. In emergencies, contractor must deploy additional vehicles if required. d. Contractor must issue identity cards with photograph to employees. (8) The contractor shall not engage any person of less than 18 yrs. (9) The Firm have to submit INTEGRITY PACT. (10) If the Service Provider fails to fulfill the desired services satisfactorily, the contract may be terminated at any time during three years. (11) Eligibility Criteria of the Bidder: The bidder must have an experience of Three (05) years for providing placement services to Governmen t Organizations/PSUs. The bidder is required to furnish experience certificate of providing Vehicle services from the concerned Government Organizations/PSUs along with the follo wing documents: (i) Copy of Income Tax PAN Card. (ii) Copy of valid GST Registration Certificate. (iii) Copy of the valid Registration Certificate (Employers code number) issued by the RPFC Authority i n the name of the Agency/Firm as per the EPF Scheme. (iv) Copy of valid Registration Certificate under ESI Authority and Employer’s Code. submitting recentl y file d EPF challan copy .
